column3: Close to the Hebrew; “A man of rebukes” is rendered “after much reproof,” and “there will be no healing” as “beyond remedy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Sighs” is rendered “groan.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Destroys” is rendered “wastes.”
Close to the Hebrew; “A man of contributions” is rendered “a man who takes bribes.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“In the transgression of an evil man [is] a snare” is rendered “By transgression an evil man is ensnared,” and “cries aloud” as “sings.”
“Knowledge” is rendered “such concern,” and “the case of poor people” as “the rights of the poor.”
Close to the Hebrew; “People of mockery” is rendered “Scorners,” and “inflame” as “set … aflame.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “either … or.”
“They seek his life” is rendered “are concerned for his life.”
Close to the Hebrew; “All his spirit he sends forth” is rendered “always loses his temper.”
Close to the Hebrew; “A word of falsehood” is rendered “falsehood,” and “servants” as “ministers.”
Close to the Hebrew; “They meet together” is rendered “have this in common.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “A youth let loose” is rendered “a child who gets his own way.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Their overthrow” is rendered “their fall.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Discipline” is rendered “Correct,” and “give you rest” as “give you comfort.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Let loose” is rendered “unrestrained.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “alone” and “though.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Anyone” is rendered “a man.”
The final word (glossed “trouble”) is rendered “find him to be a son.” The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “A master of rage” is rendered “a hot-tempered man.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “Has shares with” is rendered “is a partner with.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Set on high” is rendered “exalted.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The face of a ruler” is rendered “the ruler’s favor.”
